# flow order

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:flowOrder`](gmeow-flowOrder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/flowOrder>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/procedures`](../../slices/procedures.md)

An explicit ordering index on a control-flow edge, used when the graph structure alone is insufficient to determine sequence (e.g. linear pipelines). Optional; the default ordering mechanism is the [`ControlFlow`](../classes/gmeow-ControlFlow.md) graph structure plus Allen relations at the [`Execution`](../classes/gmeow-Execution.md) level.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:ControlFlow`](../classes/gmeow-ControlFlow.md) -> [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:flowOrder`](gmeow-flowOrder.md) from [`gmeow:ControlFlow`](../classes/gmeow-ControlFlow.md) to [`xsd:integer`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#integer) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
